title: Rate Lock Commitment Rate Sheet Schedule: Lock Terms and Term Price Adjustments
content:
Larkspur Home Lending prices every **Rate Lock Commitment** from the rate sheet, then adjusts the price for the length of protection bought. This schedule fixes, for each Rate Lock Commitment product, the term of the lock and the term price adjustment.

**Lock term.** The lock term is the number of calendar days counted from the lock date to the original expiration date. It is a whole number of days.

**Term price adjustment.** The term price adjustment is the price adjustment, in points (stated to 3 decimals), added to the rate-sheet price for the term. A negative figure lowers the price; a positive figure raises it.

**Rounding of point prices.** Point prices on every Rate Lock Commitment are rounded to the number of decimal places shown in the last column.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Lock term (calendar days) | Term price adjustment (points) | Point prices rounded to (decimal places) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 15 | -0.125 | 3 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.000 | 3 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 45 | 0.125 | 3 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 60 | 0.250 | 3 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 90 | 0.500 | 3 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 120 | 0.875 | 3 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 180 | 1.500 | 3 |

### Reading the schedule

- The shortest term, the Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock, is the only product whose term price adjustment is below zero (-0.125 points); the Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock carries no adjustment (0.000 points).
- The adjustment rises with the term, from 0.125 points for 45 days to 1.500 points for the 180-day new construction lock.

*Hypothetical illustration (inputs chosen for the example only):* a rate whose rate-sheet price is 0.375 points, locked under the Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock, carries 0.375 plus 0.250, that is 0.625 points; the same rate under the Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock carries 0.375 less 0.125, that is 0.250 points.
